reviews.text: I really like how they pay attention to detail and always have my furbaby looking good!
They did an awesome job with my hairy chihuahua teddy thank you ladies

Super friendly and you can tell she loves animals.
I have been taking my dogs to her for years.
I have taken my German shepherd twice and have been very satisfied with their work. Bath, nail trim and hair trim was at an affordable price. I recommend this place.

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but I wanted to share my experience for other pet owners.

The two stars is because they really did a great job with his grooming. But….

My dog is normally very social and happy to go with anyone, but during his last two visits he showed clear signs of stress. This time, he resisted going to the back (which is very unlike him) and was shaking uncontrollably when I picked him up after each visit. I had completely forgotten that he had reacted this way on his first visit. Seeing him shaking so badly today brought me to tears because I instantly remembered it from his last visit.

Additionally, when I arrived, I heard a staff member in the back yelling loudly at a dog to “shut up,” which was uncomfortable to witness.

I understand grooming can be stressful for some dogs, but the combination of my dog’s reaction and what I observed makes me feel this is not the right environment for him.

I would recommend asking questions and observing carefully if you bring your pet here.

I considered calling to voice my concern but decided against it. I really don’t want the drama. I’m going with my gut.

I regret taking my dogs back here after previous incidents, and this visit confirmed that concern. Every time they come here, they return with injuries. This time, one of my dogs had a significant scratch on her paw, and her eye is extremely red and irritated.
At this point, this is no longer an isolated incident — it is a pattern. Whether this is due to poor handling, unsafe conditions, or lack of supervision, it is unacceptable. Dogs should never come home injured from a place that is supposed to provide care.
I went there a few days ago, the nice blonde lady had good customer service.
They always do a good job on both of my dogs and when they come out of there they smell and look good

DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOG HERE!!!!! they listened the first time and we were pleased with the service. Today, was a horrible/different outcome! My yorkie was supposed to only get a sanitary cut which is trimming the fur from the  underbelly, anus, and genitals. He came back bald !!! All the hair that was being grown on top of his head and ears and face was cut off !!  So angry because it took 8 months to get the hair length and they just did their own thing and charged full price for it !!!
Julián León came out lookin' like a little lion.

I’ve been a loyal customer of Le Paws for years, and I can confidently say this is the best grooming salon I’ve ever brought my pets to. The owner, Pam, is incredibly knowledgeable—if you have a question about your pet, she’ll have the answer. Her passion and experience really show.

Haley, the assistant, is always so warm and welcoming. She makes drop-off feel easy and comforting, both for you and your furry friend.

To those leaving negative reviews complaining about smells or barking—let’s be real for a second. It’s a pet grooming salon. Dogs bark, they have accidents, and yes, sometimes it smells like a place that works with animals all day. That’s completely normal. And for those upset that their dog “screams” during nail trims—that’s probably why you’re bringing them to professionals in the first place!

Le Paws does amazing work, treats your pets with care, and always goes above and beyond. Keep up the great work! I’ll see y’all in two weeks!

DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG HERE.

I originally had an appointment for today, but ended up having the day off so I called to see if I could get Bailey in a day early. To my surprise they were very willing to take her. Here’s where I blame myself. I ignored my gut. My gut told me this wasn’t the place for my dog, however I chalked it up to it being a new place and I was just nervous. I love my dog with all my heart and ultimately she is all I have. So I’m very protective of her. I asked what I needed to bring with me and they said her rabies shot info. I said okay I’ll see you shortly. Upon arrival I came in and no one was at the front desk. So I waited a couple minutes because clearly they had to hear the door. It’s not a light door. I eventually said hello, and no one came. I could hear them in the back so I said it louder. No one came. At this point I wanted to turn and leave just off of what I saw in the back. Dirty walls, a hole in the wall. Dirty floors, and two cats just lying around. The place had a weird smell and I was just so nervous. Again.. not listening to my gut. Eventually I moved closer to the counter and said hello louder… this lady comes from the back.. and says “for Bailey” not the friendliest person but okay not everyone is gonna crack a smile. But any previous groomer I’ve gone too has always had an upbeat personality because working with dogs is like working with children. You should be excited to see them! She never asked for the shot records which was a huge red flag but again.. I’m torn between my anxiety and my gut feelings.. I’m not sure which one was in charge. So she asked me what kind of cut I wanted for my dog. I said she normally gets a puppy cut. She said okay that’s for the face, what about the body? I said I want her low, but not too low. She mentioned a summer cut. I said yeah, sure just not too low. I hand Bailey over she called her cute and then took her back. When I returned to get Bailey I asked how she did. She said “fine, she was my favorite dog today” that made me feel good. I paid and left a tip. When she brought me my dog she kind of gave her to me fast and walked away. I knew from the moment I saw her something was wrong. She curled up in my arms and didn’t even want me to put her down in the car. I then looked at her closely and was like.. “they shaved my dog” just shaved her down to the point where you could see her individually toes to her paws. Her face was cut uneven and she look like she was given bangs! I laughed it off and was like this is a terrible cut we definitely won’t be coming back here. I get home and I notice she’s licking everywhere she’s clearly irritated. But there was one place she kept licking and it was in between her arm and chest. I look and there is a cut. I freaked and called the groomer instantly! I asked them about the cut. They said that they didn’t see it, her assistant didn’t notice anything, and that the dog would have responded if she was cut. They offered for me to come back up there so that they can see and put some antiseptic on it. I knew I was upset and my dog was shaking and teeth chattering so that told me she was scared of something so of course I was hesitant to bring her back. Both for my sake of getting upset and hers cause clearly she was scared. Her entire butt is shaved and I can see all of her private areas and her butt hole as clear as day… mind you I have a maltipoo there is no reason I should see all of that. My dog looks like a chihuahua right now and I just needed you all to know. Don’t do it! I will definitely be requesting a refund! The second to last picture is how I gave them to her… WHAT THE HELLY!!! I brush my dog often so I know she was not matted and shaving her was not necessary!! The last picture is her after a grooming from our old groomer… if you don’t know how to do a puppy cut. Just say that! Worse experience ever.
Always take great care of our dogs!
They are always good with our pet and her haircuts always look great!

The owner is very sweet!! We were able to get my Pomeranian brushed out instead of shaving those spots! Very happy with the service and would definitely go again!! She even gave us complimentary treats!! I highly recommend going here!!!

Terrible experience – do NOT recommend!
I took my cat to Le Paws Grooming Salon for a simple haircut, and it was a complete disaster. When I picked him up, he was visibly traumatized and terrified. To make things worse, they didn’t even trim him properly
– absolutely NOTHING was done. Yet they still had the nerve to charge me $67 for doing literally nothing. This place is unprofessional and clearly does not care about animals or customer satisfaction. Save your money and go somewhere that actually knows how to treat pets properly!
Awesome customer service!!! Happy to help your pets, I recommend this place if business!!!!😀😀😀😀 …

Took my dog for a nails trim and my dog was screaming, the next day my dog was not walking, im thinking the  lady pull his arm they had horrible attitude, the blond lady and the other old lady was wearing pijamas, also this place smells horrible cats all over the place DONT TAKE YOUR DOGS there my dog needed to put down, due she pulled his arm,

My puppy goes full zoomies mode anytime I try to brush or trim him and he was starting to look like a feral thing, Le Paws took the challenge on perfectly and now my boy is looking regal and smelling wonderful, so excited to have found them!
My dog a very shy little guy but they did an amazing job with his cut and he enjoyed his complimentary treats after

Great services. Groomed 2 cats and a large lab, all in great spirits and with shiny coats.
Our dog usually smells a week after a grooming but with Le Paws, it took about 2 weeks- leading me to believe that they are more thorough and use better products.
Frosty came back great,  He was taken care of very well. Will be returning.

I’ve had good experiences here so far.  I bring my Shepherd Husky mix and because of her very long thick hair she gets mats behind here ears.  They have been able to untangle her and remove the mats.  Her coat always looks beautiful when I pick her up.  Fair prices as well.

I’ve always had a great experience here at Le Paws. They’ve always treated my Rottweiler great and she always looks forward to coming. The staff is nice and welcoming. They do a good job and prices are fair. They always give you dog a new bandana and treats. I will always recommend this place!

Edit: Tuesday June 16 2024

Once again I've shown up to this place on a Tuesday and it's closed. They have written on their sign on the door that they're now closed Tuesday. Its frustrating that these guys are the closest to me. Taking an hour leave to get off work early to take care of my dogs nails can make someone upset. As mentioned in my earlier review, they have not updated their hours om their website and on Google.
Im reducing my rating from 3 stars to 1 until this changes. Sad to say, I'll be back again and I'm anticipating I'll be disappointed again. It's probably time to find a way to do it myself or another place that's closer.

Original review:
They actually are very good. It just sucks when Google and the Le Paws website says their hours are open on Tuesday and they're actually not. Lights are off and no activity inside, no sign on the door saying theyre closed as an exception and no posted hours are visible from outside. It just sucks to plan your day to drive here and it was a waste of time.

I'll give 5 stars next time I show up and they're actually open during business hours.
Excellent service
